trigger_receipts.note: planned_at is DERIVED from the previous firing's completion + rrule interval (the scheduler anchors hourly rules to the completion moment); the raw historical next_run_at is overwritten on every run and is NOT_RECORDED.

field_notes.unrecorded: stage-level events (activate_next_city / run_places_batch / staging postprocess / completion checks) are NOT persisted per run; current_step only holds the first step. Reported as NOT_RECORDED rather than reconstructed from source.

city.source: bd_leads.db:retail_city_queue + lead_discovery_query_state + lead_discovery_results + provider_request_audit + system_config; completion rules from production retail_city_queue.city_completion_checks

stage_events.reason: NOT_RECORDED: the orchestrator persists no per-run stage event log. Durable proxies only: lead_discovery_query_state (discovery), provider_request_audit (provider calls), retail_city_queue counters. No stage trace is reconstructed from source code.

observable_proxies.run_places_batch: provider_request_audit rows dated inside the run window

canonical_automation.automations_last_run_at_note: automations.last_run_at is stale/unreliable; automation_runtime_state.last_run_at is authoritative

reconciliation_model.method: PAIRWISE: planned(next) = completed(previous) + rrule interval, because the scheduler re-anchors HOURLY rules on run completion, so an absolute grid cannot match and would report false misses

workbuddy_drivers.name: BD SAFE40 Milestone Checkpoint — 4x/day (6h interval) Asia/Shanghai
BD checkpoint phase fix (one-off, 07:38) — restore +40 min offset
BD Production Evidence Refresh — 22:40 (read-only, no inventory)

windows_service.name: BDExecutionHost
windows_service.method: Read-only SCM QueryServiceStatusEx + registry Start value; no start/stop/delete, no schtasks/sc.exe shell-out

scheduled_tasks.reason: schtasks.exe / sc.exe are blocked by host policy; no equivalent read-only enumeration is available from this process, so task-level uniqueness stays UNKNOWN

uniqueness.basis: exactly one ACTIVE non-deleted WorkBuddy automation is classified role=INVENTORY, no ACTIVE orchestrator-referencing automation is UNCLASSIFIED, and the BDExecutionHost service is not RUNNING; Windows scheduled tasks remain UNKNOWN by policy

verdict.note: a firing that produced no job_runs row is classified firings_without_production_run, NOT automatically a missed firing: the agent layer can refuse to execute fail-closed (e.g. network gate).

safe.method: select_candidates_for_plan_v2 on a mode=ro connection; SAFE = distinct organization_key over the returned candidate rows; two consecutive readings reported because MX resolution is live and could be jittery

filters.note: per-candidate history/suppression/business-fit decisions are made inside select_candidates_for_plan_v2 and are not separately re-exposed here

new_customer_funnel.dedup_rule: discovery window: distinct COALESCE(normalized_domain, normalized_business_name|city); lead window: distinct organization_key
new_customer_funnel.timezones: discovery window compares UTC ISO; lead window compares leads.collected_at (+08 local, literal 'T' separator)
new_customer_funnel.note: merchant discovery != confirmed business identity != has email != SAFE customer

safe_net_growth.reason: no prior snapshot recorded under an identical rule_version + dedup definition; the ledger started with this measurement, so growth cannot be subtracted from readings produced by an older rule set
